name: runway-ai
description: Preview-first Runway Dev CLI: credit balance, usage and task lookup for free; text-to-image, text/image-to-video and sound effects spend credits only with --yes, under a per-call credit ceiling, downloading outputs into a contained --out and auditing every paid task
hits: Runway Dev API (api.dev.runwayml.com; paid, the operator's own credits)
surface: CLI only. `models`, `balance`, `usage`, `task` read. `image`/`video`/`audio` preview (endpoint, model, ratio, duration, credits, output paths) and exit 0; `--yes` submits the task, waits for it, and downloads every output into `--out`; 120 credits per call and 4 images per call are code constants; an audit line per paid task on stderr and in ~/.local/share/runway-ai/audit.log

origin.note: Written in the belt from https://dev.runwayml.com/quickstart.txt and the docs it links (api.md, guides/models.md, guides/pricing.md). The quickstart's `npx skills add runwayml/skills` step is not taken: the belt has one router skill and this CLAUDE.md is the contract. The Runway Dev MCP (OAuth, https://dev.runwayml.com/mcp) is not registered here

install.description: Install the official @runwayml/sdk locally from the committed lockfile
install.why: every network verb imports it; the SDK sets the X-Runway-Version header and polls tasks
install.yes: node_modules/ is created inside tools/runway-ai; no call to Runway is made
install.no: skipped; `models`, previews and the tests still work, every network verb fails on import

env.name: RUNWAYML_API_SECRET
env.description: Your Runway Dev API key (key_…) from https://dev.runwayml.com, billed to your own credits. Alternatives: ~/.config/toolbelt/runway-ai.key or tools/runway-ai/.env (gitignored), both mode 600. Not needed for `models` or any preview

auth.flow: A static API key the operator creates in the Runway Dev portal, billed to their own organization's credits; read from $RUNWAYML_API_SECRET, else a 600-mode key file outside the tree, else the gitignored tools/runway-ai/.env; sent only as the Bearer header by the SDK, never printed, logged or placed on argv
auth.login: Create a key at https://dev.runwayml.com → API Keys, then either put RUNWAYML_API_SECRET=key_… in tools/runway-ai/.env (chmod 600) or: mkdir -p ~/.config/toolbelt && umask 077 && printf '%s\n' 'key_…' > ~/.config/toolbelt/runway-ai.key

caches.note: optional 600-mode key file; resolveKey() in rwy.mjs refuses a group/world-readable one
caches.revoke: Delete the key at https://dev.runwayml.com, then rm ~/.config/toolbelt/runway-ai.key

caches.note: in-tree fallback the operator chose; gitignored by tools/runway-ai/.gitignore, and resolveKey() refuses it unless mode 600; the key_your_… template value counts as absent
caches.revoke: Delete the key at https://dev.runwayml.com, then remove the line from tools/runway-ai/.env

safeguards: Preview by default: image and video print the endpoint, model, ratio, duration, credit cost and its basis, the request body (a data-URI image elided), the output stem and whether a credential was found, then exit 0 without a network call; only --yes submits (rwy.mjs main(), renderPreview()) — the flag tier for paid-but-private spend (SENSIBILITIES #2, #5)
--yes is always honored: the operator's own credits on a private surface, so the gate prevents the accidental call and never refuses the deliberate one (SENSIBILITIES #2)

Ceilings are code constants in rwy.mjs that no flag raises: MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL = 120 and MAX_N = 4 images per call; a request above either is refused with exit 2 naming the constant; before submitting, spend() refuses a call the credit balance cannot cover (SENSIBILITIES #3)

Only priced models are callable: lib/models.mjs lists each model's ratios, durations and credit formula from the Runway docs; any other --model, ratio or duration is refused before a call, so every submitted task was priced first
The create call runs with maxRetries 0, so a network retry cannot submit (and bill) a second task; reads keep the SDK's default retries

Containment: --out <dir> is required to spend, every file is written inside it, --name is [A-Za-z0-9._-] only, the filesystem root and home directory are refused, an existing output stem is refused before any credit is spent, and downloads open with O_EXCL

Audit line per paid task, on stderr and appended to ~/.local/share/runway-ai/audit.log (dir 700, file 600): timestamp, verb, model, task id, terminal status, estimated and charged credits, files written or the failure text — never the key or the prompt (SENSIBILITIES #7)

Timeouts: 60 s per HTTP request; task waits of 5 min (image) and 15 min (video); a timed-out or interrupted wait prints the task id and the `rwy task <id> --out` command that collects it without spending again (SENSIBILITIES #8)

The key comes from $RUNWAYML_API_SECRET, ~/.config/toolbelt/runway-ai.key or the gitignored tools/runway-ai/.env; a group/world-readable file is refused; the preview reports only whether a credential was found and from where (SENSIBILITIES #11)
The tiers are a table in the code (VERBS in rwy.mjs) and the test suite asserts this manifest's verbs[] matches it

verbs.name: models
verbs.note: priced models, ratios, durations and credit rates from lib/models.mjs; no network

verbs.name: balance
verbs.note: GET /v1/organization — credit balance, monthly cap, per-model tier limits; free

verbs.name: usage
verbs.note: POST /v1/organization/usage — credits per model per day, up to 90 days; a query, changes nothing

verbs.name: task
verbs.note: GET /v1/tasks/{id} — status, cost, failure; with --out downloads a succeeded task's outputs (no new spend)

verbs.name: image
verbs.note: paid, private: POST /v1/text_to_image (muse_image 1 credit/image, gen4_image ≤8); --ref [tag=]<image> for character/style consistency (gen4_image ≤3 tagged, muse_image ≤10); preview then --yes; n ≤ 4

verbs.name: video
verbs.note: paid, private: POST /v1/text_to_video or /v1/image_to_video (gen4.5 12 credits/s, gen4_turbo 5 credits/s, 2–10 s); preview then --yes; ≤120 credits per call

verbs.name: audio
verbs.note: paid, private: POST /v1/sound_effect (eleven_text_to_sound_v2, 1 credit/s, 1–30 s, --loop); preview then --yes

verbs.name: task cancel/delete, recipes, characters, routers, uploads, speech/dubbing, workflows
verbs.note: no verb exists; DELETE /v1/tasks/{id} also deletes a finished task's outputs, and the other surfaces are unpriced here

risk.worst_case: up to 120 credits ($1.20) of the operator's own Runway credits per --yes call, and media files written under a directory the operator named; nothing is deleted or overwritten

checks.fix: cd {TOOLBELT}/tools/runway-ai && npm ci   (or: toolbelt setup runway-ai) — the network verbs need @runwayml/sdk; previews and tests do not

smoke_test.command: node rwy.mjs models >/dev/null && node rwy.mjs video 'smoke test' --out output | grep -q 'PREVIEW, nothing sent' && node --test test/*.test.mjs
smoke_test.expect: the model table renders; a paid verb previews and makes no call; unit tests green — key precedence and mode refusal, ceilings, per-model validation, containment, data-URI elision, manifest/VERBS parity
